obligations.behavior: Fork retries retain one captured source operation and publish only materialized member refs
obligations.trace: Entry rediscovery uses the requester/key or identical active request. Resume rejects mismatched digests, preserves captured manifests, creates members, and finalization verifies operation-owned refs before publishing child metadata and completion in one SQL transaction. Optional issue/chat outcomes are attached to that finalization.
limits: Fresh admission authorization, actual live capture, ref creation/cleanup primitives and some child-row insert lines were not reread; no complete fork proof.
Optional chat failure preservation is a recovery refinement of existing fork intent; not proposed as a separate ontology rule.

obligations.behavior: Owner deletion stops compute and removes a workspace with governing no-orphan cascade semantics
obligations.trace: Delete route requests stop, refuses non-stopped outcome, reacquires write/owner authority, then calls deletion and commits. Service locks repository membership, refuses live children, active merges or pending forks, and rechecks that no VM is active before tombstoning.
limits: Observed live-child refusal disagrees with existing cascade/extra-confirmation intent; this is a known implementation mismatch, not a missing rule.
Physical branch removal, tombstone retry and undelete paths were not followed beyond this selected refusal/admission boundary.

obligations.behavior: Review starts in a reader-owned child, can resume that child, and retains a created copy if compute start fails
obligations.trace: Start rechecks source read, serializes source/reviewer lookup and fork admission, reuses a durable copy when present, and releases admission before resume. Resume failure returns the copy and reason. Branch-based review capture and Save readiness are explicitly distinguished from transitional/non-running compute.
limits: The unique source/reviewer reuse shape is an implementation choice, not independently recovered intent here. Fork/resume helpers were not followed end to end.
Nested-review/transfer restrictions are not promoted over supplied ordinary-workspace/review intent.

obligations.behavior: Successive review rounds supersede open snapshot work while preserving valid proposal history
obligations.trace: Push saves the copy, captures/generates its round, rejects stale selected keys, then records the publication. create_publication serializes round allocation and retires only previous same-author/same-shape round work. insert_generated_suggestions and carried_by_push distinguish identical proposal occurrence/content from changed or duplicate proposals, reuse threads, preserve decided state/notes for eligible continuation and retain persistent artifacts.
limits: No new execution or model covers this trajectory; ReviewAcceptance covers settlement within an edit identity, not cross-round identity.
In-place agent rounds, every artifact delivery consumer and hunk identity helper implementation are not exhaustively verified.

obligations.behavior: Reviewer can discard selected previewed changes from their own copy without overwriting later work or changing the source
obligations.trace: Discard admits the copy owner/reviewer and running owner handle, saves and regenerates the preview, refuses stale change keys, compares live files with the captured saved content, and guardedly deletes/reverses selected changes. It reports successful versus skipped changes per outcome and only credits a file after its write succeeds.
limits: Generic VM mutation preconditions already own the low-level hash/publication safety; proposed addition is the selected review-copy operation and outcome, not another file-write owner.
No runtime test or proof of native-writer atomicity; UI unsaved-editor confirmation and cross-file crash reconciliation are outside this pass.

obligations.behavior: A pushed Approve review verdict can settle listed formal approvals, including a requestless path
obligations.trace: After the review publication commits, Approve invokes sync. It requires the copy to contain the source vector and the current exact vector to match under the workspace commit fence. Each phase settles independently; missing/retired requests can lead to request_id=None through the shared service. Other verdicts leave formal approvals alone, and sync failures do not roll back the pushed round.
limits: No newer human resolution found for the explicitly recorded issue278 requestless-sync exception and withdrawal question. Identity reviewer independently found none.
The full shared approval writer and current UI Undo path were not reread here; do not infer universal authorization or call all source behavior intended.

obligations.behavior: Eligible readers publish additive file suggestions with detected-stale confirmation and no source write
obligations.trace: Reader/content admission precedes the authorized bounded file read and is repeated in the transaction that inserts an annotation publication and suggestions. Stale base requires explicit allow_stale_base; annotation publications do not replace earlier pushes. This route creates neither a review VM nor a source file mutation.

obligations.trace: Organization route validates member-write admission and freezes domain selection for the call. obligations.behavior: Question answers preserve revision/receipt identity and distinguish applied answers from published files
obligations.trace: Owner route captures authorized docs and checks file mutation before the service. Answer reads the live set, checks retained receipt before current revision, rejects reused keys, retries file-hash races, and sends people through selected Save while agent proposals remain live. Replay with an applied hash publishes only equal current bytes; lost-response replay compares committed receipt/revision.
limits: The contract parser transition helper that enforces original human author ownership was not reread, nor agent caller admission.
Selected Save is reused and retains its existing exact-content/native-writer gaps; there is no separate answer-publication guarantee.

obligations.behavior: Reader question votes remain personal advisory records bound to the resolved question revision
obligations.trace: Vote route resolves the question through an authorized captured read and reacquires current read authority before the write. Service validates offered choices/revision, upserts by workspace/path/question/voter, withdraws only that voter, and emits after commit. It writes no answer or Git file.
limits: Viewer write eligibility remains an already-recorded Q, not a new omission. The optional expected revision compares the resolved snapshot, not a latest-at-commit lock.

proposals.confidence: medium-high recovered agent design; no new human policy inferred
proposals.text: Review copy pushes record committed work as successive rounds. A new round supersedes the same reviewer’s earlier open changes and findings from the same kind of review, while standalone annotations and persistent comments/artifacts remain. Continue discussion without merging distinct proposals; carry a decision and unchanged note only to the same proposal at its evidenced occurrence and content. Changed proposals require a fresh decision.
proposals.why_existing_insufficient: review-decisions retains history across displays and prevents stale reopening of one suggestion. It does not define identity across later round rows, retirement of old snapshot work, or unchanged-versus-changed proposal carry-forward. Reader suggestions owns additive annotations, not replacing copy rounds. A replacement can satisfy both existing blocks while repush loses or wrongly duplicates decisions.

original_records.qualification: Saved agent design explicitly recovers threads carrying over rounds from PR170 and identifies supersession notification semantics.

original_records.detail: Unchanged proposals retain decision rather than reopen.
Same occurrence is required, not merely equal before/after text.
Exact predecessor reservation avoids duplicate edit stealing another decision.
Changed artifact bytes require a new decision while thread continues.

limits: Exact anchor algorithms, round-number SQL and specific kind enums are mechanisms, not proposed ontology.
Do not convert ordinary review into compulsory merge or sealed result workflow.

proposals.confidence: medium recovered product behavior from original merged records
proposals.text: A reviewer may discard selected previewed changes from their own review copy without changing the source. Refuse stale selections and preserve files changed since the preview instead of reversing at a guessed location. Report completed and skipped changes separately; one failure does not conceal changes already discarded. File mutation remains governed by the shared VM mutation rules.
proposals.why_existing_insufficient: Review/fork isolation says changes do not alter the parent and file mutation governs safe writes. Neither requires the reviewer’s selected change-discard capability or its preview-bound selection/partial outcome. A replacement may preserve all current contracts while leaving rejected changes permanently in the copy.

original_records.detail: Original rationale: rejected changes otherwise stay forever in Changes to push; adds Discard from my copy and changes nothing on source W.
Discard must refuse files changed since the saved preview.
Artifact content belongs to change identity; changed artifact needs a fresh preview.

limits: Low-level hash checks are already governed; no new physical immutability or whole-request atomicity promise.
Original commits are recovered agent design, not quoted human instruction; current supplied review intent remains authoritative.

proposals.text: May a listed reviewer’s Approve verdict on their own review round record a formal approval without an eligible pending request, and how may that reviewer withdraw it? If this separate path is retained, define its exact reviewed-cut/current-read authority and per-phase partial settlement; request-changes/comment verdicts do not implicitly reject formal approval, and a sync failure does not undo the published round.
proposals.why_existing_insufficient: The human-authority block grants addressed pending-request settlement, and cut eligibility defines which evidence counts. Neither authorizes this alternate requestless writer. Earlier issue278 human H2 retains owner-only requestless direct decisions, while its reviews explicitly leave review-sync exception and withdrawal unresolved. Adding a broad D based on the existing service would silently choose policy.
